title: Riemannian optimization with finite-difference gradient approximations
summary: Derivative-free Riemannian optimization (DFRO) aims to minimize an objective function using only function evaluations, under the constraint that the decision variables lie on a Riemannian manifold. The rapid increase in problem dimensions over the years calls for computationally cheap DFRO algorithms, that is, algorithms requiring as few function evaluations and retractions as possible.
